context.en: This late-Republican gem portrays Julius Caesar, whose dictatorship is part of this account of Rome’s republican crisis. Its miniature profile makes political portraiture visible at the scale of a personal object.
context.zh: 这枚共和国晚期宝石刻有尤利乌斯·凯撒侧像；他的独裁统治是本篇共和危机叙事的重要环节。微型头像让政治肖像以随身物件的尺度呈现。

context.en: Hiroshige’s nineteenth-century print remembers Murasaki Shikibu, author of The Tale of Genji discussed in this account of Heian courtly writing. The Ishiyama setting is a later artistic remembrance.
context.zh: 广重的十九世纪版画追忆紫式部；她所著《源氏物语》是本篇平安宫廷书写故事的重要作品。石山寺场景属于后世艺术追忆。

context.en: Jane Addams appears with Alva Belmont in this 1912 drawing. Addams co-founded Hull-House with Ellen Gates Starr; Belmont, the other sitter here, should not be mistaken for Starr.
context.zh: 这幅1912年的素描绘有简·亚当斯与阿尔娃·贝尔蒙特。亚当斯与艾伦·盖茨·斯塔尔共同创办赫尔之家；画中另一位人物贝尔蒙特并非斯塔尔。
